sn22.159:1.1: Sāvatthi || ārāme || || Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || || upasaṅkamitvā || pa || Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yam aham Bhagavato dhammam sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || ||
sn22.159:2.1: Taṃ kiṃ maññasi Ānanda || Rūpaṃ niccam vā aniccaṃ vā ti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || || Dukkham bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallaṃ nu tam anupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attā ti || || No hetam bhante || || Vedanā || Saññā || Saṅkhārā || Viññāṇaṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vāti || || Aniccam bhante || || Yam panāniccam dukkhaṃ vāti-sukhaṃ vā ti || || Dukkhaṃ bhante || || Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ || kallaṃ nu taṃ samanupassituṃ Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || || Tasmā ti hānanda yaṃ kiñci rūpam atītānāgatapaccuppannam || || Evam passam || pa || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Diṭṭhivaggo pañcamo || ||
sn22.159:3.0: Tassuddānaṃ || || Ajjhattikam Etam mama Eso me attā No ca me siyā || Micchā Sakkāya Attānu dve || Abhinivesā Ānandenāti || Uparipaññāsakuddānaṃ || || Antaṃ
sn22.159:4.0: Vijjā Samudayañ ca || Kukkulaṃ Diṭṭhi pañcamaṃ || Tatiyo paññāsako vutto Nipāto ti pavuccatīti || || Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ
